top_100_news_candidates.text: The first known runaway AI agent - or a very bad marketing stunt? The first known runaway AI agent - or a very bad marketing stunt? Martin Alderson's commentary on the OpenAI accidental cyberattack against Hugging Face includes a couple of details I hadn't considered. First, Hugging Face offers a truly rich target if you're trying to find potential vulnerabilities that require executing arbitrary code: Hugging Face has an enormous attack surface. They have more interfaces than I can count which run untrusted models and code. While they definitely have invested in defences, by nature of their operating model they do have many more opportunities to be attacked than many other services. I certainly don't envy their cybersecurity teams. Secondly, one of the things that has puzzled me is how OpenAI didn't notice that their sandbox had been so thoroughly breached by the agent. Surely they'd be monitoring network traffic closely? top_100_news_candidates.text: GeoTransolver AI Model Architecture Integration for CFD Applications Power complex and high-accuracy AI surrogate models for CFD and FEA with GeoTransolver model architecture. Now available in Rescale AI Physics as part of the NVIDIA PhysicsNeMo library, GeoTransolver is a geometry-aware transformer architecture that uses GALE attention to model relationships across complex 3D geometries and unstructured meshes. top_100_news_candidates.text: Building trade assistant: How Jefferies optimized front office trading operations with AI In this post, we explore how Jefferies overcame these challenges with a solution built on Strands Agents, an agent harness SDK for building AI agents that can reason, plan, and act by orchestrating calls to foundation models (FMs) and external tools. The solution uses large language models (LLMs), Amazon Bedrock, and Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases.
